description: It’s no big deal , everything’s fine.#selflove #confidence #selfmastery
transcript: How it goes is how it goes. I am not concerned with the outcome. Once the ball is in my hands, the ball is in my hands. Once it's not, maybe that's time for me to take a break. And that's okay. There is nothing that enters my life without me noticing it. There is nothing that can create space in my internal world without me opening the door and allowing it in. My day-to-day to my relationships, they are seamless. I live a life of flexibility and the more that I prioritize flexibility, I move within ease. I am not stressed about what's on the other side because however it goes is how it's going to go.
